description: Seat board: post an open crew request as the leader (board only; returns no transaction, nothing unsigned to send). Say the game, an optional short ref, and the seats you want as role numbers (0 = any). Others see it with open_seats. Each who joins must still send their own yes on chain.

game.description: heist, convoy, ledger, raid or nightrun.

have.description: How many other wallets you already seated by hand (default 0).

hours.description: How long the request stays open, 0.1 to 24 (default 2).

ref.description: A short label of the target, e.g. vehicle 12 or hit 3.

roles.description: One role number per seat you want filled (0 = any role). Role ids differ per game: see the prepare tools.

name: post_crew_request
